checks: Never send old text on failed copy.
Late result ignored even if cancellation fails.
results.input:
When a user copies a paragraph twice, the application should show the copied text and start translating without another click. The first copy must still work normally in the original application.

The clipboard may update after the keyboard event arrives. Wait briefly for the current copy, but do not send old clipboard content if the copy failed. If another paragraph is copied while translation is running, ignore the previous response even if cancellation was unsuccessful.

Measure completion when the entire translated paragraph is visible, not when the first word appears. Report errors and timeouts separately, and include them when calculating the proportion of attempts that finish within one second.

When a user copies a paragraph twice, the app should show the copied source text and start translation without additional clicks. The first copy should work as usual in the original app.

The clipboard may be updated after a key input event arrives. Wait briefly for this copy, but if the copy fails, do not send the previous clipboard content. If another paragraph is copied during translation, ignore the previous response even if cancellation fails.

Measure completion time when the entire translated paragraph is visible, not when the first word appears. Record errors and timeouts separately, and include them when calculating the percentage of attempts completed within one second.
